newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dublin Port sets freight throughput record in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Dublin Port sets freight throughput record in 1996.

text.p: Dublin Port set a record by becoming the first Irish commerical port to reach a freight throughput of 15.2 million tonnes in 1996, the Dublin Port and Docks Board said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said the previous highest total for any Republic of Ireland commercial port was the 11.9 million tonnes achieved by Dublin Port in 1995.
Dublin Port and Docks Board said that Dublin Port was now the leading RoRo freight port in the Republic of Ireland.

"We have invested 44 million punts in Port infrastructure, eight million punt of that in Ferryport where last year we had a throughput of 785,000 passengers. We expect to increase passenger numbers even further with our new terminal open to open Autumn of this year," Enda Connellan, chief executive of Dublin Port and Docks Board, said.
